product_overview: Cloud-hosted perpetual inventory management API for All World Trailers (AWT) providing role-based access, CSV import tooling, transaction types (receipts, adjustments, transfers, production), and inventory valuation/analytics.
core_goals: Replace manual/mental inventory tracking with a single source of truth (Postgres + Prisma).
Provide fast transactional workflows for receipts, adjustments, transfers, opening balances, and production/kitting.
Support bulk data onboarding via CSV preview+commit for vendors, items, and opening balances.
Enforce role-based permissions (admin vs user) and audit trails for all transactions.
Expose dashboard and reports (low stock, dead stock, valuation, recent activity) for operational visibility.
Keep APIs secure (JWT auth), rate-limited where appropriate, and validated to prevent bad data.

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: Lightweight endpoint to verify the API is running and return a timestamp.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 {status: 'ok', message, timestamp}
GET /api/health when server has internal error -> Receive 500 with error message

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: JWT-based authentication for login/logout, session inspection, and self-service password changes with rate limiting on login.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with {username, password} (valid credentials) -> Receive 200 with {token, user} -> GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile -> POST /api/auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 acknowledgement
POST /api/auth/login with {username, password} (invalid password) -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
POST /api/auth/login repeated >10 times within 15s from same IP -> Receive 429 Too many login attempts
POST /api/auth/change-password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {currentPassword, newPassword} (current correct, new meets policy) -> Receive 200 Password changed successfully
POST /api/auth/change-password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {currentPassword (wrong), newPassword} -> Receive 401 Current password is incorrect
POST /api/auth/change-password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {currentPassword, newPassword (weak)} -> Receive 400 Validation error (weak password)

features.name: User Management API
features.description: Admin-only CRUD and activation control for user accounts (no hard delete; isActive used for soft-delete).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/users with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with users list -> POST /api/users with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {username, password, fullName, role: 'user'} -> Receive 201 with created user -> PUT /api/users/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {fullName, role} -> Receive 200 with updated user -> PATCH /api/users/:id/status with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {isActive:false} -> Receive 200 with user object
POST /api/users with Authorization: Bearer <token-of-non-admin> -> Receive 403 Admin access required
POST /api/users with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body {username already exists} -> Receive 409 Username already taken
PATCH /api/users/:id/status with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body {isActive:false} for own account -> Receive 400 Cannot deactivate own account

features.name: Item Management API
features.description: Admin CRUD for inventory master data, list/search, status toggles, and CSV import preview + commit.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/items with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemCode, description, category, unitOfMeasure, minQuantity, maxQuantity, standardCost, defaultVendorId, notes} -> Receive 201 with item object -> GET /api/items with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with items list
POST /api/items with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemCode already exists} -> Receive 409 Item code already exists

POST /api/items/import/preview with Authorization: Bearer <token> and multipart/form-data file=items.csv -> Receive 200 with {rows: normalizedRows, errors: [] or errors} -> POST /api/items/import with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {rows: validatedRows} -> Receive 201 {inserted: number}
POST /api/items/import/preview with Authorization: Bearer <token> and no file -> Receive 400 No file uploaded or CSV parse error

features.name: Vendor Management API
features.description: Admin CRUD for vendor master data and CSV import preview + commit.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/vendors with Authorization: Bearer <token> and vendor body -> Receive 201 with vendor object -> GET /api/vendors with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with vendors list
POST /api/vendors with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {vendor_code already exists} -> Receive 409 Vendor code already exists

POST /api/vendors/import/preview with Authorization: Bearer <token> and multipart/form-data file=vendors.csv -> Receive 200 with {rows, errors} -> POST /api/vendors/import with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {rows} -> Receive 201 {inserted: number}
POST /api/vendors/import/preview with Authorization: Bearer <token> and malformed CSV -> Receive 400 CSV parse error

features.name: Receipt Transaction API
features.description: Create RECEIPT transactions for vendor receipts (single and atomic batch), auto-update lastPurchaseCost, and surface last paid prices for variance checks.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/transactions/receipts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId, vendorId, location, quantity, unitCost, transactionDate, invoiceNumber?, notes?} -> Receive 201 with transaction and lastPaidPrice -> GET /api/transactions/stock-position with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 showing updated stock position
POST /api/transactions/receipts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId not found, ...} -> Receive 404 Item not found

POST /api/transactions/receipts/batch with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {vendorId, location, transactionDate, lineItems:[{itemId, quantity, unitCost}, ...]} -> Receive 201 with transactions array and lastPaidPrices
POST /api/transactions/receipts/batch with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body referencing missing vendor or some missing items -> Receive 404 Vendor not found or some items not found

features.name: Opening Balance Transaction API
features.description: Admin tool for initial inventory counts via single entry or CSV import (preview + commit).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/transactions/opening-balances/import/preview with Authorization: Bearer <token> and multipart/form-data file=openings.csv -> Receive 200 with {rows, errors} -> POST /api/transactions/opening-balances/import with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {rows} -> Receive 201 {inserted}
POST /api/transactions/opening-balances with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId invalid} -> Receive 404 Item not found or inactive
POST /api/transactions/opening-balances/import/preview with Authorization: Bearer <token> and no file -> Receive 400 No file uploaded or CSV parse error

features.name: Adjustment Transaction API
features.description: Record inventory corrections for damage, shrinkage, cycle counts, or other reasons (quantity must be non-zero).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/transactions/adjustments with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId, location, quantity (non-zero), reason, notes?} -> Receive 201 with transaction
POST /api/transactions/adjustments with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {quantity: 0} -> Receive 400 Validation error or quantity is zero
POST /api/transactions/adjustments with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId not found} -> Receive 404 Item not found or inactive

features.name: Transfer Transaction API
features.description: Atomically move stock between locations by creating paired TRANSFER transactions (outbound negative + inbound positive), validating sufficient stock.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/transactions/transfers with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId, fromLocation, toLocation, quantity, notes?} (sufficient stock) -> Receive 201 with {transfer:{outbound, inbound}} -> GET /api/transactions/stock-position with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 updated quantities
POST /api/transactions/transfers with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {fromLocation == toLocation} -> Receive 400 Same locations or insufficient stock
POST /api/transactions/transfers with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {quantity greater than available} -> Receive 400 Insufficient stock

features.name: Stock Position API
features.description: Retrieve paginated aggregated inventory position per item and location with weighted average cost valuation.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/transactions/stock-position?page=1&limit=50 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with positions, total, page, limit, totalPages
GET /api/transactions/stock-position without Authorization header -> Receive 401 No token or invalid token

features.name: Transaction History API
features.description: Filtered, paginated audit trail of all transactions with filters by type, location, date range and item.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/transactions?itemId=123&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-01-31&page=1&limit=50 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with transactions, total, page, limit, totalPages
GET /api/transactions with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid date range parameters -> Receive 400 Validation error (bad date format) or filtered empty result

features.name: Dashboard API
features.description: Aggregated operational stats and lists for low stock, dead stock, valuation, and recent activity for quick decision-making.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/dashboard/stats with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with aggregated counts (totalItems, transactionsMTD, activeVendors, teamMembers, overstockCount)
GET /api/dashboard/low-stock with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with items below threshold including burn rate and daysRemaining
GET /api/dashboard/stats without Authorization header -> Receive 401 No token or invalid token

features.name: Cycle Count API
features.description: Workflow for cycle counting (create, capture counted quantities, post adjustments, void counts) with variance history and CSV export support. Admin-only where stated.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/cycle-counts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {location, itemSelection, blindCount?, assignedTo?, notes?} -> Receive 201 with cycleCount and lineCount -> PUT /api/cycle-counts/:id/lines with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {lines:[{lineId, countedQty}, ...]} -> Receive 200 with linesUpdated and status -> POST /api/cycle-counts/:id/post with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with adjustmentsCreated
POST /api/cycle-counts with Authorization: Bearer <non-admin-token> -> Receive 403 Admin access required (if admin-only)
PUT /api/cycle-counts/:id/lines with Authorization: Bearer <token> providing invalid lineIds -> Receive 400 Validation error
POST /api/cycle-counts/:id/void with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> -> Receive 200 with status 'VOID'

GET /api/cycle-counts/variance-history with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> -> Receive 200 with lines and totals -> GET /api/cycle-counts/variance-history/export with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> -> Receive 200 CSV file

features.name: BOM Management API
features.description: Admin CRUD for Bills of Materials with lifecycle (DRAFT->ACTIVE->RETIRED), cloning, and uniqueness rules (one ACTIVE per finished good).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/boms with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {bomCode, name, finishedGoodId, lines:[{itemId, quantityPer, notes?}]} -> Receive 201 with bom and lines -> PATCH /api/boms/:id/status with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {status: 'ACTIVE'} -> Receive 200 status changed to ACTIVE (and any prior ACTIVE BOM for same finishedGood auto-retired)
POST /api/boms with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {bomCode that already exists} -> Receive 409 BOM code already exists
PUT /api/boms/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> when BOM status != DRAFT -> Receive 400 Not in DRAFT status
POST /api/boms/:id/duplicate with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 201 with cloned BOM (bomCode suffixed with '-COPY' and status DRAFT)

features.name: Production / Kitting API
features.description: Execute kitting/production orders that consume component stock and produce finished goods atomically, calculating costs from weighted averages or fallback standardCost.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/production/kit with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {finishedGoodId, location, quantityProduced, bomId or components:[{itemId, quantityPer}], notes?} (sufficient stock and valid BOM) -> Receive 201 with ProductionOrder (orderNumber KIT-{id}), totalCost, and related transactions
POST /api/production/kit with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {components requiring more stock than available} -> Receive 400 with insufficientItems error (insufficient stock)

GET /api/production with Authorization: Bearer <token>?page=1 -> Receive 200 with orders list and pagination -> GET /api/production/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with order detail and linked transactions
